    THE QUICK START

    Keep the shop flowing.

    1. Grab the matching stock.ROUND or PLATE in First Shift; BLOCK joins in Mixed Orders. Each bin starts the earliest-due ready order of that type. In Mixed Orders and Rush Hour, prepare CAD at the office first. Stay for six seconds; leaving pauses it.
    2. Follow the route.Load a machine, leave it running, then collect the finished part. A green label means it is ready.
    3. Inspect it. Ship it. Repeat.Complex parts earn more. Park a part on the Hold bench to free your hands.

    WASD / ↑↓←→ Move E / Space Use station

    Shift Dash Esc / P Pause

    Click the floor to walk, or click a station to walk over and use it. Keep working on the shop floor when customers call. At the office, answer before doing CAD: a three-second conversation, then accept a rush or keep the original promise. Machines and deadlines keep running. A rush earns +100 on time or costs 25 if missed. In Mixed Orders and Rush Hour, after two normal shipments, a customer part may need a capability outside this shop. Choose Covari to place it, collect the delivery at Receiving, run QC, then ship for 300 points. Saying no has no penalty. Outsourced parts do not count toward shipment stars. Night Shift adds Deburr and the Anodize color bath between machining and inspection; there are no calls or Covari offers on that shift.
